domainWarnings.detail: murakamiLaw: steel-derived small-defect law, R = -1 threshold amplitude; applied to AM alloys as a transfer
Murakami's small-defect law was derived for steels; it is applied to Ti-6Al-4V as a transfer
The cited Ti-6Al-4V applications are EBM and forged specimens, not this LPBF state.
The supplied size is 70 micrometres. The cited radlof2020 EBM Ti-6Al-4V vertical specimen study reports 120 to 300 micrometres. This is a size-domain extrapolation.
The supplied size is 70 micrometres. The cited radlof2020 EBM Ti-6Al-4V horizontal specimen study reports 75 to 200 micrometres. This is a size-domain extrapolation.

validity.uncertaintyStatement: Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.
validity.explanation: Uncalibrated estimate: about 350 MPa fully reversed stress amplitude for an internal defect with projected square-root area 70 micrometres and hardness 330 HV. This is a defect-conditioned Murakami screening estimate for an R = -1 threshold scenario. It is not a fatigue strength at a stated cycle count and not an infinite-life endurance limit. Mixed measured and assumed inputs. The cited Ti-6Al-4V applications are EBM and forged specimens, not this LPBF state. Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.

uncertainty.construction: Murakami sqrt(area) law at the supplied size and hardness; no interval.

Extrapolated from 5 block maxima to 100 target blocks

validity.uncertaintyStatement: Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.
validity.explanation: Uncalibrated estimate: the largest defect in the target volume is about 95 micrometres sqrt(area) at probability 0.5 from a Gumbel fit to 5 block maxima. The fit has only two moments and does not establish tail adequacy. Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.

uncertainty.construction: Method-of-moments Gumbel fit; quantile at p^(V0/V); no interval.
